title: Sony Fighting GTA 6 PS5 Piracy with New Firmware Demands
description: PlayStation is taking strict measures against PS5 jailbreaks, piracy, and hacking attempts by requiring new firmware as GTA 6 approaches.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Sony Fortifies PS5 Against Piracy Ahead of GTA 6 Launch

As the gaming community edges closer to the highly anticipated release of *GTA 6*, platform holders are taking zero chances when it comes to security. According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, PlayStation is actively combating PS5 jailbreak, piracy, and hacking attempts through strict new firmware demands.

### Tackling Firmware Exploits and AI-Driven Hacks

Reports indicate that beginning from the start of last month, hackers targeted PS5 firmware versions v7.00 through v13.60, attempting to crack the system using AI tools. In response to these vulnerabilities, Sony has wasted no time. The company has rolled out multiple PS5 firmware updates designed to shut down potential emulators and block ongoing hacking efforts for the current-generation console.

This proactive approach highlights the immense stakes involved as the industry prepares for *GTA 6*. Safeguarding the platform against piracy and unauthorized modifications is critical not only for protecting the software ecosystem but also for ensuring a secure and fair online environment for millions of players worldwide.

### Editor's Take

With *GTA 6* on the horizon, Sony's aggressive stance on firmware security is entirely justified. While mandatory updates can sometimes cause minor friction for users, maintaining a tightly secured platform is essential to protect the integrity of the ecosystem and ensure the biggest launch in gaming history goes off without a hitch.
